part_number.note: 17-character part number. The SEL-2488 data sheet and instruction manual do NOT contain a printed Model Option Table (SEL publishes it only via their online configurator), so this block was calibrated against the master drawing i7114.J part-number template plus three real part numbers (2488PRAX1281AX2XX from the data-sheet web dashboard, 24880RAX1181AX2XX and 24880RAX1181BX23X from field units). Positions 1-4 (2488), 11 (8), 12 (1) and 15 (2) are FIXED template characters. The five graphic-affecting groups are anchored high-confidence: mounting (6), power supply A (7), power supply B (8), Ethernet ports (9-10) and frequency outputs (14). NOTE: the model_to_layers source.position values are all shifted low relative to the real part numbers - GROUP_2 (PS-A) is layer pos 6 but real pos 7; GROUP_3 (PS-B) layer pos 7 -> real 8; GROUP_4 (Ethernet) layer pos 8 -> real 9; GROUP_5 (frequency) layer pos 10 -> real 14. The real part numbers were trusted over the layer positions. Positions 5, 13, 16 and 17 are the drawing's 'dashed' (non-graphic) configurable slots; they are not tracked by the drawing layers and there is no MOT, so their meanings are inferred from the three real part numbers only and are LOW confidence.
references: SEL-2488 master configuration drawing i7114.J (part-number template + option layers)
Real part numbers: 2488PRAX1281AX2XX (data-sheet Fig 6 web dashboard), 24880RAX1181AX2XX, 24880RAX1181BX23X (field units)

Field unit. Rack mount, PS-A 125-250 V, no PS-B, (4) 10/100Base-T Ethernet (code 11), no frequency outputs, no PTP (pos 5 = 0).
Field unit. Rack mount, PS-A 125-250 V, no PS-B, (4) 10/100Base-T Ethernet (code 11), no frequency outputs; pos 13 = B and pos 16 = 3 (non-graphic options, meaning unconfirmed).

positions.label: PTP Option (inferred)
positions.note: Drawing 'dashed' (non-graphic) slot, not in the drawing layers and no MOT. Inferred to encode the IEEE 1588 PTP grandmaster firmware option: the data-sheet unit has pos 5 = P and its web dashboard shows PTP masters active on ETH1-4; both field units have pos 5 = 0 with no PTP. PTP is an ordering option that updates the part number (per the instruction manual). Meaning inferred, not doc-confirmed.

positions.label: Holdover Oscillator (inferred)
positions.note: Drawing 'dashed' (non-graphic) slot, not in the drawing layers and no MOT. Best inference is the internal holdover oscillator option (the SEL-2488 offers standard TCXO plus optional OCXO and DOCXO). Observed A (two units) and B (one unit); the code->oscillator mapping is NOT confirmed and a third value (likely DOCXO) was not observed.

options.A: Holdover oscillator option A (likely TCXO / standard) - inferred, unconfirmed
